app: the care home conformance app: one app whose screens a care home's staff would use, its component bench and refusal routes as the test infrastructure they are, run under a closed set of host variants; every browser test of the framework runs on one of its screens

areas.care: a screen a care home's staff uses; it holds only what a user does
areas.bench: the component bench: the object-surface variations of the custom components, which are no business behavior
areas.refusals: one route per refusal where the view renders, each a deliberately broken view whose error the test reads

harness.seed: writes the test's own data under its world key, through typed builders
harness.gate: holds a named TLA+ action of the test's world until the test releases it; the test waits until the harness reports it held
harness.push: makes the server push a stream or hub message to the test's world
harness.drop: ends the test's stream or hub connection and holds the browser's next one until reopen
harness.reopen: lets the held next connection in
harness.restart: makes a component's host destroy its object and put a new one on the same element
harness.clock: Playwright's Page.Clock, for every timer a plan carries
harness.gc: Playwright's Page.RequestGCAsync, confirmed by the page's own weak hold

partKinds.native: a plain-DOM input or element the core's doors render or reach
partKinds.conformance: a declaration of the conformance library, spec/Reference/native.json, named by the part's declares
partKinds.fusion: a Syncfusion component through its Fusion slice; never a part of a core module's test
partKinds.nativeSlice: a Native slice's component (NativeDrawer, NativeToast, NativeConfirm, NativeLoader, NativeActionLink, NativeCheckList and the rest)
partKinds.endpoint: a server endpoint the screen's requests reach

hosts.what: ASP.NET Core MVC on net10 with the app's default options: camel-case members and enum names, Fusion registered, ShowBusy() with NativeLoader, ShowReconnect() with the Native offer, request defaults sending X-Requested-With with a 401 route, a catch-all, ShowValidationErrors() and the standard retry, antiforgery in a header, Flags<CareDays>() and Flags<RotaDays>() named, its process clock in America/New_York
the MVC 5 twin on net48 under IIS, the same models, controllers and views, its process clock at UTC, run by verify-net48
the app's JSON options write numbers as text
the app's JSON options add a DateTime converter that writes dd.MM.yyyy
the app's JSON options name members in snake case
the app's JSON options name members by their C# names, no naming policy
the app's JSON options ignore members that hold their default (WhenWritingDefault), respect required constructor parameters, and remove Admission.Pharmacy through their resolver
the app's JSON options write enums as numbers
AddReactiveClassNames with Bootstrap's invalid-feedback and is-invalid
the OpenTelemetry adapter with an exporter that throws on every span
the OpenTelemetry adapter registered, exporting to the test app's collector, with a sampler the test steers per request
request defaults whose WhileLoading awaits the session plugin's Renew and whose Finally appends defaults finally and awaits Flush, each settled at once unless the test holds it
ShowBusy() with no script that provides the busy component
AddReactiveRealtime choosing neither ShowReconnect() nor NoReconnectOffer()
ShowReconnect() with no script that provides the reconnect component
an app that never calls AddReactiveRequests
a layout that renders FusionToast and FusionConfirmDialog in place of the Native ones
